id_routing.description: Interconnect may append bits to AxID to identify the originating master; slave-side ID_WIDTH > master-side ID_WIDTH
id_routing.compliance_note: Returning ID is the WIDER value; routing strips appended bits before returning to the master

fields.topology_type: Source-synchronous low-power mobile memory bus. The controller (master) drives the quarter-speed CK, the 7-bit DDR CA bus, CS, and on-demand full-speed WCK to one or more LPDDR5 SDRAM devices (slaves) per channel; the DRAM drives RDQS during reads. Mobile LPDDR5 is soldered directly to the SoC board (or PoP-stacked), typically as a two-channel (x16 per channel) package with an internal two-deck organization. There is no removable DIMM and no CKE pin.

supported_topologies.name: Single controller + single LPDDR5 die
supported_topologies.description: Point-to-point on the SoC board / PoP; one x16 channel.

supported_topologies.name: Single controller + multi-die LPDDR5 package
supported_topologies.description: Multiple dies; per-channel CS / clocks select dies.

supported_topologies.name: Two-channel x16 package
supported_topologies.description: Two independent x16 channels per package.

supported_topologies.name: Package-on-Package (PoP) over the AP
supported_topologies.description: LPDDR5 stacked on the mobile application processor.

master_slave_role_summary.description: Generates quarter-speed CK and on-demand full-speed WCK; issues all commands on the CA bus; performs WCK2CK sync; tracks per-bank state; manages refresh (ab/pb), ZQ calibration, read/write training, link ECC, DBI, DVFS; sources DQ on writes, sinks DQ on reads.

Decodes commands from the 7-bit DDR CA bus; opens/closes rows (two-ACT); locks internal WCK to CK during WCK2CK sync; drives DQ + RDQS on reads, sinks DQ + DMI on writes; generates internal refresh; supports deep sleep and CA-bus-bounded power-down.

fields.interconnect_role: There is no LPDDR5-protocol-layer interconnect (no router / bridge). The bus is a flat 1-controller : N-device per-channel bus. Device selection is via CS; bank/bank-group via BG/BA; row/column via the CA address fields. Channels are independent.

ordering_guarantees.within_a_burst: 16 (BL16) or 32 (BL32) beats per the LPDDR5 column addressing (B0-B3 / C0-C5); RD32 may start within the 32-word-aligned burst via C0/B3.
ordering_guarantees.across_commands: Commands committed in issue order; tCCD_L/tRRD_L (same group), tCCD_S/tRRD_S (different group), tFAW, and refresh timing serialize commands; every high-speed transfer requires a prior WCK2CK sync.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: The LPDDR5 SDRAM exposes a linear DRAM array as a bank-group x bank x row x column space plus a mode-register space via MRW/MRR. Mode-register / ZQ / training commands use the same CA bus but do not access the array.

device_classification.multi_die_package: Multiple LPDDR5 dies in one package (per-channel CS / clocks).
device_classification.LPDDR5_controller: Controller + PHY IP integrated into the mobile SoC.
device_classification.two_deck_device: LPDDR5 device with the two-deck internal organization.
